title: TenantContext
description: Machine-readable contract schema for validated bOPEN tenant context payloads v1.0.0

context_id.description: Unique identifier for this validated execution context

principal_id.description: Identifier of the authenticated principal (human, service, device, agent)

tenant_id.description: Identifier of the active commercial and security tenant boundary

organization_id.description: Optional organization identifier within the tenant boundary

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace identifier within the tenant boundary

active_membership_id.description: Identifier of the active principal-to-tenant membership

roles.description: Assigned roles within active tenant context

issued_at.description: Timestamp when context was validated and issued
